test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: Recession in industry is associated with the:
solution:
The correct answer is a **cyclical component**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A cyclical industry is one that responds to the** business cycle**, with revenues typically being higher during periods of economic expansion and prosperity and lower during periods of recession and contraction.
 
• Businesses in cyclical industries can deal with this type of instability by implementing staff cutbacks and layoffs to make up for lost income during lean **economic times**, and by giving bonuses and hiring en masse during booming economic times.
 
• In reality, a **recession **is a particular kind of vicious cycle with cascading decreases in output, employment, income, and sales that feedback into a further decline in output, quickly spreading from industry to industry and region to region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A recession, according to the NBER, lasts anywhere from a few months to more than a year and occurs between the peaks and troughs of a business cycle when there is a significant decline in economic activity across the board. 
 
• Cyclical industries produce or market goods that we can live without or put off purchasing during difficult economic times. Luxury products, leisure vacations, and new construction are a few examples.

**Hence, recession in the industry is associated with the cyclical component.**
